name: Disarming Dummy
disable: DC 18 Thievery check (trained) to jam the rotor or DC 25 Athletics check to knock the dummy over

items.name: Hold On!
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves adjacent to the trap

---
Effect The trap makes a single Athletics check with a +17 modifier to Disarm the creature.

text: A leather strap on the dummy's mechanical arm swings around, knocking items out the hands of anyone adjacent.
